preview:
Gulf shrimp, crab and grouper straight off the boats — the Destin Seafood Festival runs Sept 25–27 along the harbor boardwalk, about 35 minutes west.

Saturday goes 10 AM to 10 PM and closes under fireworks.

Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Sun 27, 2 nights: three king bedrooms, a firepit-quiet back patio, and the beach walk three minutes away.

Come home salt-tired and let the evening go slow — link in bio to book.

The Destin Seafood Festival takes over the harbor boardwalk Sept 25–27 — free to attend, 75+ vendors, five music stages, and fireworks at Saturday's close, about a 35-minute drive west of us. Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Sun 27 (2 nights), with three king bedrooms, a private patio and Pelayo beach access a 3-minute walk away.
